purpose: Crop-to-soil suitability with a 0-100 score and an ICAR-style suitability band.
collection_mode: Knowledge synthesis from documented public sources (WebFetch to government domains blocked by environment egress policy)
methodology: Every one of the 45 crops carries two rows: its optimal soil and a documented alternative, giving 90 mappings. Scores are a relative ordinal rating anchored to ICAR guidance (85+ optimal, 70-84 suitable, 55-69 marginal), not a measured yield ratio.
known_limitations: suitability_score is ordinal and comparable only within a crop, not across crops. Absence of a crop-soil pair is not a statement that the combination fails.
